standard_prerequisites.use: Only standard Sard and integration facts are assumed; the moving-point weighted conditional-law argument is local.

core_obligations: Construct the regular conditional distribution and establish all original z-KROK requirements under the stated regularity and bounded nowhere-vanishing noise-density assumptions.
difficulty_reason: Constructs an explicit regular conditional law on the field space varying with the evaluation point, proves its Jacobian-weighted continuity, and combines this with Sard transversality for random shifts. The complete conditional-law and continuity arguments are retained; the result supplies fields satisfying the hypotheses rather than assuming an admissible field for an expectation formula.

dedup.scope: Same-source counted targets are the alpha-moment formula, oriented expected current and Crofton/HT-volume identity, which assume admissible fields. This target constructs admissible random fields and their conditional laws. The multitransversality corollary and Gaussian/noise special cases are not counted separately.
